title: Janice S. McNair, Texans co-founder and former owner, dies at 89

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Janice S. McNair, Texans co-founder and former owner, dies at 89
sources.description: Houston Texans co-founder Janice S. McNair has died. The team confirmed her death in a statement Tuesday evening, saying she passed away peacefully.
